name: Triangle: Corner Pass
idea: The wing passes to the corner, then the post sets a back screen so the wing can cut to the hoop.
why: After the pass to the corner, the wing's defender turns to watch the ball. A back screen from the post catches them from behind, and the wing gets a free run to the basket.
tryit: Corner: catch, look inside first, then look for the cutter. Post: set the back screen right behind the wing's defender, then get ready to set a pick for the corner if nothing is open.

frames.say: {1}, {2} and {5} are in the triangle. Watch what happens when {2} passes to the corner.
{5} steps out and sets a *back screen* on {X2}, right behind {X2}'s back.
{2} cuts to the hoop, and {X2} runs right into {5}!
Layup! Pass to the corner, back screen, cut. That's the corner pass.
